subject: TUN
name: Tunisia
note: Each claim is one rendered observation on the canonical page. IDs are TL:<subject>:<measure>:<vintage> and stable across builds: a changed value under the same ID is an upstream revision (recorded in the ledger at /ledger); a new observed year is a new claim. A null or absent figure mints no claim — absence is never zero. Scheme: https://terralore.co/integrity

claims.title: Foundation of Carthage
claims.summary: Phoenician settlers from Tyre establish Carthage, which grows into a dominant Mediterranean trading power.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-814bce-foundation-of-carthage, claim TL:TUN:event:814bce:foundation-of-carthage, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Hannibal's war on Rome
claims.summary: In the Second Punic War Hannibal invades Italy with elephants and wins at Cannae, before defeat at Zama in 202 BCE.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-218bce-hannibal-s-war-on-rome, claim TL:TUN:event:218bce:hannibal-s-war-on-rome, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Rome destroys Carthage
claims.summary: Roman armies raze Carthage in the Third Punic War; its lands become the province of Africa.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-146bce-rome-destroys-carthage, claim TL:TUN:event:146bce:rome-destroys-carthage, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Augustus refounds Carthage
claims.summary: Carthage is rebuilt as the capital of Africa Proconsularis, a prosperous grain-exporting Roman province.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-29bce-augustus-refounds-carthage, claim TL:TUN:event:29bce:augustus-refounds-carthage, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Amphitheatre of El Djem
claims.summary: The colossal amphitheatre of Thysdrus is built, the largest Roman amphitheatre in Africa and a later UNESCO World Heritage Site.

sources.label: Amphitheatre of El Jem — World Heritage List

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-238-amphitheatre-of-el-djem, claim TL:TUN:event:238:amphitheatre-of-el-djem, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Vandals take Carthage
claims.summary: Gaiseric's Vandals seize Carthage, making it the capital of a kingdom in North Africa.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-439-vandals-take-carthage, claim TL:TUN:event:439:vandals-take-carthage, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Byzantine reconquest
claims.summary: Belisarius restores Carthage to the Eastern Roman Empire, ending Vandal rule.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-534-byzantine-reconquest, claim TL:TUN:event:534:byzantine-reconquest, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Founding of Kairouan
claims.summary: Uqba ibn Nafi establishes Kairouan with its Great Mosque, the first Arab-Muslim capital of the Maghreb.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-670-founding-of-kairouan, claim TL:TUN:event:670:founding-of-kairouan, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Aghlabid dynasty
claims.summary: The Aghlabids rule Ifriqiya from Kairouan, rebuild the Great Mosque in stone, and conquer Sicily.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-800-aghlabid-dynasty, claim TL:TUN:event:800:aghlabid-dynasty, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Fatimid Caliphate
claims.summary: The Shia Fatimids overthrow the Aghlabids; after moving to Cairo in 972 they leave the Zirids to govern locally.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-909-fatimid-caliphate, claim TL:TUN:event:909:fatimid-caliphate, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Hafsid dynasty rules from Tunis
claims.summary: The Hafsids make Tunis a prosperous capital of trade and learning until the Ottoman conquest.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-1229-hafsid-dynasty-rules-from-tunis, claim TL:TUN:event:1229:hafsid-dynasty-rules-from-tunis, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ottoman conquest of Tunis
claims.summary: The Ottomans take Tunis from Spain, making Tunisia an autonomous province of the empire.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-1574-ottoman-conquest-of-tunis, claim TL:TUN:event:1574:ottoman-conquest-of-tunis, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Husaynid dynasty founded
claims.summary: Al-Husayn ibn Ali is proclaimed bey, founding the dynasty that rules Tunisia until 1957.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-1705-husaynid-dynasty-founded, claim TL:TUN:event:1705:husaynid-dynasty-founded, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: First written constitution
claims.summary: Tunisia adopts the Arab world's first written constitution amid attempts at modernising reform.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-1861-first-written-constitution, claim TL:TUN:event:1861:first-written-constitution, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Treaty of Bardo
claims.summary: The bey signs the Treaty of Bardo, placing Tunisia under a French protectorate.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-1881-treaty-of-bardo, claim TL:TUN:event:1881:treaty-of-bardo, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Neo-Destour founded
claims.summary: Habib Bourguiba and colleagues break from the Destour to form the Neo-Destour, the engine of the independence movement.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-1934-neo-destour-founded, claim TL:TUN:event:1934:neo-destour-founded, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Tunisian independence
claims.summary: France recognises Tunisian sovereignty; Bourguiba becomes prime minister.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-1956-tunisian-independence, claim TL:TUN:event:1956:tunisian-independence, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Republic proclaimed
claims.summary: The monarchy is abolished and Tunisia becomes a republic with Bourguiba as first president.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-1957-republic-proclaimed, claim TL:TUN:event:1957:republic-proclaimed, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Code of Personal Status
claims.summary: Bourguiba's government bans polygamy and expands women's rights, a landmark reform in the Arab world.

sources.label: Code of Personal Status in Tunisia

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-1956-code-of-personal-status, claim TL:TUN:event:1956:code-of-personal-status, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ben Ali takes power
claims.summary: Zine El Abidine Ben Ali removes Bourguiba in a bloodless coup, beginning twenty-three years of authoritarian rule.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-1987-ben-ali-takes-power, claim TL:TUN:event:1987:ben-ali-takes-power, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Mohamed Bouazizi self-immolation
claims.summary: A street vendor sets himself alight in Sidi Bouzid, triggering nationwide protests.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-2010-mohamed-bouazizi-self-immolation, claim TL:TUN:event:2010:mohamed-bouazizi-self-immolation, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Jasmine Revolution ousts Ben Ali
claims.summary: Ben Ali flees the country; the uprising sparks the wider Arab Spring and a Tunisian democratic transition.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Tunisia: From Carthage to the cradle of the Arab Spring", terralore.co/country/TUN/chronicle#ev-2011-jasmine-revolution-ousts-ben-ali, claim TL:TUN:event:2011:jasmine-revolution-ousts-ben-ali, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.
